text: Can execute page actions using natural-language instructions
extract() pulls structured, schema-shaped data from a page via instruction + output shape
quote: extract() grabs structured data from a webpage. Every call takes an instruction and an output shape

text: observe() discovers actionable elements and returns them as previewable actions before executing
quote: observe() discovers actionable elements on a page and returns structured actions you can execute or validate before acting.

text: Supports falling back to plain Playwright page methods when you already know the selector
quote: When you know the selector or want zero inference, use page methods you already know.

text: selfHeal option re-infers an action automatically when its recorded selector breaks
quote: Turn on `selfHeal` to re-infer an action when its recorded selector breaks.

text: Caches act/observe/extract results server-side to cut LLM cost and latency on repeat runs
quote: Stagehand caches `act()`, `observe()`, and `extract()` results server-side to reduce LLM costs and speed up your automations.

text: Persists local browser profile (cookies, local storage) across runs via a user data directory
quote: Stagehand creates the directory if it does not exist and leaves it in place after the browser shuts down, so the next run starts from the same cookies and local storage

text: Browserbase contexts persist browser session data across cloud runs
quote: For Browserbase sessions, use contexts to persist browser data

text: Browserbase sessions can run in one of four regions to reduce latency and meet data-residency needs
quote: Browserbase runs browsers in four regions, so you can cut latency by starting the browser near your users or your target site, and keep session data in a required jurisdiction.

text: Browserbase dashboard gives real-time browser screen recording and replay of automation sessions
quote: Browserbase provides real-time visibility into your automation sessions: **Session dashboard features** *   Real-time browser screen recording and replay

text: Exposes persistent Stagehand browser tools to a Claude Code agent over an MCP/stdio server
quote: Give a Claude Code agent persistent Stagehand browser tools over MCP/stdio.

text: WebMCP lets an agent discover and invoke a site's own tools directly instead of multi-step clicking
quote: WebMCP is the browser API for discovering those tools and invoking them directly, so a checkout flow that would otherwise take six clicks becomes one call with typed input.

text: Automatically traverses iFrames and shadow DOM elements without extra configuration
quote: Stagehand automatically handles iFrame traversal and shadow DOM elements without requiring additional configuration.

text: Can attach to any already-running Chromium browser over CDP by URL
quote: Attach over CDP (localBrowser.connect): Attach to any Chromium browser you are already running, by URL
